literature.abstract: Endometriosis and adenomyosis are two common diseases that impair women's health, and dienogest is one of the pharmacologic treatments which is the first-line therapeutic option for patients with pelvic pain and individuals who have no desire for immediate pregnancy. literature.title: A case report of ovarian granulosa cell tumor in patient with polycystic ovarian syndrome.
literature.abstract: Granulosa cell tumors (GCTs) account for less than 2% of all ovarian malignancies and are the second most common ovarian sex cord stromal tumors after fibroma/thecomas.GCTs occur most frequently in postmenopausal women with a peak age of 50 to 55, are usually diagnosed in their early stages, and have a good prognosis. repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: Dienogest 為第四代合成孕激素，透過抑制 HPO 軸（下視丘-腦垂體-卵巢軸）、降低雌二醇至卵泡早期水平，誘發閉經而非治療閉經。現有 4 項臨床試驗均以子宮內膜異位症為主要適應症，閉經（amenorrhea rate 40-70%）為藥效副作用指標，並非治療目標。機轉方向倒置（causative agent，非therapeutic agent），若定義為「治療病理性閉經」則無支持依據；若重新定義為「誘發治療性閉經」則有間接 L3 級證據。目前建議暫緩，需重新界定研究問題。

The use of prolonged courses of hormone therapy may play an important role in the strategy of overcoming endometriosis-related infertility. repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 原發性卵巢功能不全（POI）的標準治療為 HRT（雌孕激素替代）或促性腺激素；dienogest 作為純孕激素無法恢復卵巢功能或提升 AMH/卵泡儲備。唯一相關試驗（NCT04306276）探討子宮內膜異位症女性 IVF 前使用 dienogest 預處理以改善 poor ovarian response，與 POI 病理機轉（卵泡耗竭/自體免疫）僅有間接重疊。證據不支持此再利用方向。

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: Dienogest 具高選擇性孕激素受體（PR-A/PR-B）親和力及輕微抗雄活性，對乳腺組織有潛在影響。孕激素在纖維囊腫性乳腺病（FCD）中的角色雙向：PR-B 活化可抑制乳腺上皮增生，而部分合成孕激素可能增加乳腺密度。2009 年文獻直接評估 dienogest 的乳腺效應，顯示學術界已注意此關聯，但數據有限且為 2009 年前（缺乏現代 RCT 設計）。具備生物學合理性，值得以獨立研究問題進一步探索。
無合理機轉關聯。孤立性生長激素缺乏症（IGHD）病因為 GH1/GHRHR 基因缺陷或特發性，治療為 rhGH 替代療法。Dienogest 的孕激素活性與 GH-IGF-1 軸無直接調控路徑，可能的極間接連結（孕激素影響 GH 分泌脈衝）缺乏臨床支持。無任何臨床試驗或文獻，純為 TxGNN 計算分數（0.9953），需基礎實驗室驗證方可考慮。

literature.abstract: The novel coronavirus SARS-CoV-2 is the causative agent of the global coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) outbreak. In addition to pneumonia, other COVID-19-associated symptoms have been reported, including loss of smell (anosmia). However, the connection between infection with coronavirus and anosmia remains enigmatic. It has been reported that defects in olfactory cilia lead to anosmia. In this Viewpoint, we summarize transmission electron microscopic studies of cilia in virus-infected cells.

literature.abstract: The pandemic has affected over 182 million coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) cases worldwide. Accumulated evidence indicates that anosmia is one of the significant characteristics of COVID-19 with a high prevalence. However, many aspects of COVID-19-induced anosmia are still far from being fully understood. The purpose of this review is to summarize recent developments in COVID-19-induced anosmia to increase awareness of the condition.
